ann.t: Acquisition — KAMOPAINTS: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about the allotment of 2,125 equity shares by Kamdhenu Colour and Coatings Limited, a wholly owned & material subsidiary, on a right issue basis to the Company.
Acquisition — Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about an update on Acquisition of shares of wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
